benchmark_type_evidence: we introduce BUFFET: Benchmark of Unified Format FEw-shot Transfer Evaluation... BUFFET curates a diverse mix of tasks: 15 different tasks... across 54 languages
brief_description: BUFFET (Benchmark of Unified Format Few-shot Transfer Evaluation) is a benchmark for few-shot cross-lingual transfer that unifies 15 diverse NLP tasks across 54 typologically diverse languages in a sequence-to-sequence format, providing fixed few-shot examples and instructions for rigorous comparisons of multilingual language models using both fine-tuning and in-context learning.
